4399-4518-4924-8319.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Heartless Summoning.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Greenhouse Propagator trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greenhouse Propagator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-4924-8319.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3000-3510-3875-5929.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
3000-3510-3875-5929.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

3240-6462-7422-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3899-6752.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2292-3240-5631-6462.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2366-5175-5434-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5175-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-4428-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Thassa. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

5147-6602--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

4050-4276-5088-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
4050-4276-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
4050-4276-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

5086-5183-5231-6753-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6753-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

5220-6797-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1903-2440-2703.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-2593-7170.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Living Brain.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-997-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4215-6730-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
4215-6730-6798.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

518-1031-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-1031-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

3767-3918-4851-5929.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
3767-3918-4851-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
3767-3918-4851-5929.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

880-3585-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3585-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

141-167-997.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

224-2907-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-2907-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Resolve each Scute Swarm trigger, creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens or that many token copies of Scute Swarm.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

654-5412-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
654-5412-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1322-2103-3942-3982.notablePrerequisites:
If Living Lore is in your graveyard, you have not played a creature spell using Karador this turn.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1322-2103-3942-3982.description:
Cast Living Lore from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
Living Lore enters the battlefield, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage with Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

934-2257-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
934-2257-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Amorphous Axe, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-4733-5038.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4050-4733-5038.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding one mana of any color.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Overseer of the Damned triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature sacrificed.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent control.

628-687-2438-5004.notablePrerequisites: Cathodion does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-687-2438-5004.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion dies, triggering itself and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the second Cathodion trigger, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a counter from Carrion Feeder and removing both counters from Cathodion, causing you to mill three cards and allowing you to return a permanent card with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
